snip.t: Treat hypertension and fluid overload (salt and fluid restriction, diuretics, calcium channel blockers).
Fluid Overload: If present, manage with fluid restriction and diuretics.

Initial management priorities include fluid restriction, diuretics to manage fluid overload, strict blood pressure control, and urgent correction of any electrolyte abnormalities, particularly hyperkalaemia.
